snippet.title: Agent 64 - Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Coming on the 08.11.2026!
Wishlist the game on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1574480/Agent_64_Spies_Never_Die/

A retro spy FPS inspired by the N64 era. Complete varied objectives, uncover secrets, and battle enemy agents across sprawling missions. Higher difficulties introduce new objectives and challenges. Play solo, co-op, or PvP multiplayer, Online or split-screen. Bullets and secrets collide!
